evidence_against: The leg since bar 84 spends about 25 bars (87-111) inside a two-sided 2357.18-2680 band, so the leg is at least as range-like as trend-like and could be classified trading-range/channel rather than bull-trend.
Momentum faded at the highs: bar 86 spiked to 2771 but closed 2515.3 with a long upper tail, and the 2643-2850 top area shows overlapping bars rather than clean trend bars.
Bar 119 closes near its low (2684.16 in a 2641.37-2786.81 range) after a marginal new high 2850 versus the 2771 spike high, so an MTR from the high is not excluded.
The first 84 bars of the window are bearish then rangebound, so the bull case rests only on roughly the last 36 bars.
evidence_for: Higher swing lows dominate after bar 84: 2111 (bar 85 low), 2325.31 (bar 86 low), 2357.18 (bar 99 low), 2358.62 (bar 111 low), 2435.72 (bar 107 low).
Higher swing highs over the same span: 2348.02 (bar 85), 2771 (bar 86), 2680 (bar 107), 2850 (bar 117).
Bull bodies carry the advance: bar 84 opens 1916.51 and closes 2252.16, bar 107 opens 2437 and prints 2680, and bars 113-117 run from 2446.22 to a 2775.61 close.
The current two-bar set-back (bars 118-119) is no deeper than the repeated pullbacks inside the 87-111 band, which is normal pullback behavior inside a bull leg.
observations: Bars 0-10 form a bear leg: close slides from 2072.8 to 1568.55 and the window low 1368.42 is set on bar 10 (low 1368.42, close 1568.55).
Bars 11-83 are a broad two-sided base bounded by low 1512.91 (bar 30) and high 1974.46 (bar 61); bars overlap heavily and every multi-bar swing is retraced.
Bar 84 is a large bull breakout bar out of that base: open 1916.51, high 2293.8, low 1905.63, close 2252.16.
Bar 85 closes 2326.32 (high 2348.02, low 2111); bar 86 spikes to 2771 but closes 2515.3, leaving a long upper tail.
Bars 87-111 overlap in a 2357.18 (bar 99 low) to 2680 (bar 107 high) band, then bars 112-117 rally from 2358.62 to a new high 2850 (bar 117, close 2775.61).
Bars 118-119 are consecutive bear bars; bar 119 opens 2752.43, trades 2641.37-2786.81 and closes 2684.16, in the lower part of its range and below bar 118's 2752.43 close.

structures.description: Two-sided base after the opening bear leg: about 73 bars oscillating with heavy overlap between the 1512.91 low (bar 30) and the 1974.46 high (bar 61), with repeated failed pushes in both directions.

Bull spike out of the base: bar 84 (open 1916.51, high 2293.8, close 2252.16) clears the base by a wide margin, bar 85 closes 2326.32, bar 86 spikes to 2771 and closes 2515.3. No exact horizontal boundary is claimed for this impulsive leg.

Post-spike consolidation and channel-like portion of the bull leg: bars 87-111 overlap between low 2357.18 (bar 99) and high 2680 (bar 107) while keeping higher lows, so the leg is channel-like rather than a clean spike.

Two-bar bear reversal attempt at the bull high: bar 117 makes a new high 2850 and closes 2775.61, then bars 118-119 turn down and bar 119 closes 2684.16 near its low. Higher high over the 2771 spike high (bar 86) plus only two bear bars means this is a potential reversal pattern, not a confirmed reversal.

transition_conditions: Bull continuation is supported if a bar closes above 2786.81 (bar 119 high) and then above 2850 (bar 117 high) with a strong bull body and little overlap.
A close below 2641.37 (bar 119 low), then below 2435.72 (bar 107 low) and 2358.62 (bar 111 low), would break the sequence of higher lows and weaken the bull read.
A close below 2325.31 (bar 86 low) would negate the post-base breakout structure and favor a major-trend-reversal or trading-range classification.
If subsequent bars keep overlapping and closing mid-range around 2600-2800 for many sessions, the read shifts from bull-trend/channel toward trading-range/range.

evidence_against: The larger context is still a bull trend: higher swing lows (2358.62, then 2568.16, then 2633.31), a swing high 2850.00 far above the prior 2700.00, and a strong 2358.62 to 2850.00 leg (+20.8%); the pullback held well above the 2568.16 swing low, so a two-legged bull-flag pullback remains live.

The last three bars (opens 1790236800000, 1790251200000, 1790265600000) made higher lows (2633.31, 2640.00, 2660.49) and higher highs (2693.42, 2694.37, 2699.39) with bull closes near their highs - the way a range-top breakout attempt begins.

The 1790236800000 low (2633.31) trapped sellers instead of producing acceptance below the range, and the 1790251200000 bar (open 2647.90, high 2694.37, close 2682.25) recovered most of the prior bar's range, so bears had no follow-through.
The range is only about 21 bars old inside an intact bull leg, so one strong bull close above 2727.77 would make the bull-trend reading stronger than the range reading.
evidence_for: 21 consecutive bars of overlapping, two-sided trade inside 2633.31-2804.59 with no new high: the down break at 1790164800000 (2726.71 open to 2648.49 low) was reversed by the bars at 1790179200000-1790265600000, and the 2804.59 high was rejected with a return to the middle.
Retracement is deep for a simple flag: 2850.00 to 2633.31 (216.69 points) is about 77% of the preceding up leg 2568.16 to 2850.00 (281.84) and about 44% of the whole 2358.62 to 2850.00 leg.
The 1789977600000 bar closed 2723.15 with a 126.85-point upper tail under the 2850.00 high, and the three later highs (2795.00, 2804.59, 2786.81) are all lower - a climax without follow-through.

Both extremes failed their tests: 2804.59 (bar open 1790020800000) and 2633.31 (bar open 1790236800000) each produced an immediate reversal toward the middle, and the last close 2694.09 is still below the 2718.95 midpoint of the band.
The 2716.01-2727.77 breakdown shelf has not been reclaimed, so the leg down from 2850.00 has not been neutralised on the chart.
observations: 120 closed H4 bars from 1788552000000 to 1790279999999: first bar open 2454.71, last bar close 2694.09 (net +9.7%); window low 2358.62 (bar open 1789488000000), window high 2850.00 (bar open 1789977600000).
Last bar (open 1790265600000): open 2682.25, high 2699.39, low 2660.49, close 2694.09, closing at about 86% of its range after a third consecutive higher low.

Bar at 1790236800000 printed the lowest low of the last 19 bars (2633.31) but closed 2647.90, 14.59 off that low; the next bar (open 2647.90, high 2694.37, low 2640.00, close 2682.25) reversed it - a failed downside break rather than acceptance.

Since the 2850.00 spike, 21 bars have been contained in a 2633.31-2804.59 band with heavy bar-to-bar overlap, small bodies and no new high; post-spike highs were 2795.00, 2804.59, 2786.81 and 2699.39.

The advance to 2850.00 cleared the 2700.00 double top (highs of the bars at 1789804800000 and 1789948800000) but the pullback fell back below 2700.00 to 2633.31 and broke the 2716.01 higher low (bar at 1790164800000 low 2648.49), so the breakout level was not held.

Larger-leg swing lows are still rising (2358.62, then 2568.16 at 1789891200000, then 2633.31) while the most recent swing high 2804.59 sits below 2850.00, so the range has formed at the top of a bull leg.

structures.description: Post-climax trading range: since the 2850.00 spike (bar open 1789977600000), bars have churned inside a 2633.31-2804.59 band with heavy overlap, small bodies, no new high, and immediate reversals from both edges. Mid-range break line is the 2716.01-2727.77 shelf; last close 2694.09 is below the 2718.95 midpoint of the band.

Bull leg from the 2358.62 low (bar open 1789488000000) to the 2850.00 high (bar open 1789977600000): roughly +20.8% over 34 bars, including a 2700.00 double top (bars open 1789804800000 and 1789948800000) and a final vertical push; that leg is now in a pullback to 2633.31.

Buying-climax spike bar (open 1789977600000): open 2658.81, high 2850.00, close 2723.15, leaving a 126.85-point upper tail, about 66% of its 191.94-point range. Follow-through highs (2795.00, 2804.59, 2786.81) all stayed below 2850.00, so the spike high has not been retested.

Possible major-trend-reversal shape off the 2850.00 climax: lower high at 2804.59, then a break below the 2716.01 higher low (bar open 1790164800000 low 2648.49) and below the 2700.00 breakout point. There was no bear follow-through after 2633.31 and the last two bars reversed up, so this is only an unconfirmed pattern candidate that may equally be a bull-flag pullback.

transition_conditions: Bull resolution: a close above the 2727.77 high of the bar at 1790164800000, and especially acceptance above 2804.59 with overlap-free trend bars, would read as bull-trend resumption and raise always-in relevance.
Bear resolution: a close below 2633.31 with follow-through below the 2641.37/2640.00 area would confirm failure of the 2700.00 breakout and next expose the 2568.16 swing low.

Continued rotation inside 2633.31-2804.59 with overlapping bodies keeps the trading-range/range label; a squeeze into a tight 4-6 bar coil near 2699-2727 would instead be a breakout-mode setup to watch.
The always-in, currently long on the two-bar bull reversal, flips short on a close below 2633.31 and only becomes meaningful (higher relevance) on acceptance above 2727.77.
